title: Highly Anticipated 'Money Trap: The Karun Treasure' Will Be on Netflix October 16
summary: Netflix drops the official trailer for Money Trap: The Karun Treasure, the new series which brings the Money Trap phenomenon back through a brand new adventure.
body_markdown:
Netflix


drops the official trailer for


Money Trap: The Karun Treasure


, the new series which brings the Money Trap phenomenon back through a brand new adventure. Asım Noyan and his gang reunite within the series, premiering only on Netflix on


October 16th


.


To download the first look images of the series please click,


[HERE](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lhE8d2ym0ea-2aQ6sYuCy_0i_acmTti6?usp=drive_link) To watch the official trailer of the series please click,


[HERE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9MfFrWahFqw)


Produced by


BKM


,


Money Trap: The Karun Treasure


is directed by


Şenol Sönmez


. Following its two movie long journey, the story is formed into an eight-episode series written by


Yılmaz Erdoğan


, who’s been joined by


Kıvanç Tatlıtuğ, Ezgi Mola, Uraz Kaygılaroğlu, Rıza Kocaoğlu, Ersin Korkut, Okan Çabalar, Bensu Soral Baş, Atakan Çelik, Şükran Ovalı, Görkem Sevindik


and


Demet Akbağ


in the cast. Centered around the mayhem and relentless rhythm of Istanbul, the Money Trap legend follows an entertaining treasure hunt this time. The countdown begins for this new adventure extending from the streets towards the underground labyrinths of the city, as audiences get ready to reunite with the gang once again


About


Money Trap: The Karun Treasure


:


When a mysterious treasure map surfaces, Asım Noyan and his gang are drawn into a dangerous race pursued by ruthless rivals and international hunters.


Screenwriter:


Yılmaz Erdoğan


Director:


Şenol Sönmez


Producer:


Necati Akpınar


Production Company:


BKM


Cast:


Yılmaz Erdoğan, Kıvanç Tatlıtuğ, Ezgi Mola, Uraz Kaygılaroğlu, Rıza Kocaoğlu, Ersin Korkut, Okan Çabalar, Bensu Soral Baş, Atakan Çelik, Şükran Ovalı, Görkem Sevindik and Demet Akbağ
